[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Ness''' was an [[Ebruchi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] the Ebruchi [[Burning Gear (flotilla)|Burning Gear]] [[Fleet/Legends|flotilla]], a part of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi]] fleet, from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Burning Gear]]''. He served the Ebruchi [[Common Cork]] armada's high captain. Ness's [[Death/Legends|murder]] would tag his murderers as wanted escapees if they remained in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The captain was a vain Ebruchi who was pleased with challenges, trinkets, and [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ebruchi_TUR.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Ebruchi, the species Ness was a part of.]]
An [[Ebruchi]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Ness was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] the Ebruchi [[Burning Gear (flotilla)|Burning Gear]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|flotilla]]&mdash;which was part of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi]] fleet and included hundreds of pirates&mdash;from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Burning Gear]]''. The captain served the Ebruchi high captain [[Common Cork]], who led an armada. Reports from Ness could bring the [[Flux Screw fleet]]'s weight on those who did not comply to his demands, and his [[Death/Legends|murder]] would brand those who killed him as wanted runaways while they remained in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Personality and traits==
The captain was an obese, narcissistic Ebruchi sybarite who was fascinated by others' cultures and enjoyed puzzles. Ness desired stimulation, asking adventurers to tell him wonderful tales or to challenge his intelligence with riddles and games of chance. As soon as the captain became bored, however, he would shoot them with his [[shrapnel pistol]] for causing him boredom. The captain could be tricked into decreasing his anger with gifts and [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]]. He could also could be manipulated with promises of treasure, if he learned of someone's trickery, however, he would mercilessly strike back.<ref name="TUR" />

==Equipment==
Ness wore [[Gold/Legends|gold]] bands around his [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] feelers and [[Color/Legends|purple]] feathers in his expensive [[Clothing/Legends|clothing's]] junctions. The captain possessed a shrapnel [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Skills and abilities==
The captain spoke the [[Ebruchese]] and [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]] [[Language/Legends|languages]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ness was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
